query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-20T09:59:11Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T09:59:11Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.16"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS attempts = COUNT(*) BY bucket = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp), host.name, event.outcome
| SORT bucket ASC
